# Subway Seat for bottom

A `[styles]` block for bottom 0.10+: cores and sensors in stripe colours, avocado download, orange upload, orange table headers and borders.

[bottom](https://github.com/ClementTsang/bottom) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/bottom/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.toml`](subway-seat.toml) | append to ~/.config/bottom/bottom.toml |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.toml`](subway-seat-tunnel.toml) | append to ~/.config/bottom/bottom.toml |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.toml`](subway-seat-enamel.toml) | append to ~/.config/bottom/bottom.toml |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in bottom.toml (~/.config/bottom/ on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/bottom/ on macOS):

```fish
cat subway-seat.toml >> bottom.toml
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in bottom.toml (~/.config/bottom/ on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/bottom/ on macOS):

```fish
cat subway-seat-tunnel.toml >> bottom.toml
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in bottom.toml (~/.config/bottom/ on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/bottom/ on macOS):

```fish
cat subway-seat-enamel.toml >> bottom.toml
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
